chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Meeting his own "Body and Soul" arrangement in Lunceford's book
summary: A Pittsburgh arranger had written "Body and Soul" for McRae, sold it to Lunceford's Joe Thomas, and McRae played his own intro the first night.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
